coverage: Roster: SSM 998 "Editing Process", SSM "Heraldry in Westeros" (1999), the MoPOP gardener page, Not a Blog on Vance (2009), the Harper Voyager Vance piece (2013), the 1979 speech — BOTH 1979 GoH speeches, "Editors: The Writer's Natural Enemy" (10 Mar 1979) and "Critics and Reviewers" (29 Sep 1979) — Reactor on Druon (Raets 2013) plus Martin's own Druon post, and History of Westeros 2022 (full transcript) were all FETCHED. The Pajiba Groell item was BLOCKED live (403) and read from a Wayback id_ capture. The ORIGINAL Suvudu Groell Q&A is NOT FOUND (suvudu.com is dead; the Wayback CDX has no capture of the Q&A path) and is covered by two relays, Pajiba and a fan re-transcription. "García and Antonsson on his sentences" was met by three of their own texts: the La Garde de Nuit transcript (2019 interview, published 2020), the ShadowDance interview (2017) and the unsigned Citadel review of A Game of Thrones (2001 capture). Substantive sources by route: 12 live fetches with a browser user agent, 6 Wayback id_ raw captures, 0 PDFs, 0 abstract-only; 5 further pages read and logged non-substantive (one, Tower of the Hand, was an empty JavaScript shell). Expansion beyond the roster came from bibliography chasing on georgerrmartin.com (the speeches and On Writing indexes yielded the September 1979 Critics speech, "On Fantasy" 1996 and "The Usual" 1983) and from the Wayback CDX index of westeros.org; open web search was cut off at the session's 200-search budget mid-sweep, so lateral discovery stopped earlier than the method's two-empty-searches rule would have — 18 substantive sources, 78 claims, every quotation re-checked verbatim against the fetched text.
